visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a black face mask and a black T-shirt featuring a golden eye emblem, sits in a living room. He is positioned behind a light wood-colored table and gestures towards the camera with high energy. Behind him, a grey sofa and a 2023 calendar with cartoon characters on the wall are visible. (2) He lifts two bowls of instant noodles to the camera; one is purple with a Kuromi illustration and the other is pink with a My Melody illustration. He shows the seasoning packets inside each bowl. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of the bowls on the table. He lifts a clump of dark grey noodles with chopsticks to show the texture and small dried ingredients. (4) He squeezes black sauce onto the dark noodles and then shifts to the pink bowl, adding yellow powder and a dark red sauce. He uses chopsticks to mix the ingredients in both bowls. (5) He takes a large bite of the dark noodles, followed by a cut where he feeds the same noodles to a woman with glasses and a grey hoodie. She extends her tongue dramatically to take the food. (6) He tastes the pink noodles and reacts with a sudden start, indicating heat. He then feeds the spicy pink noodles to the woman, who reacts to the intensity. (7) Finally, he holds both bowls up to the camera, presenting the finished products with a look of recommendation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic male voice starts the video with high-frequency pitch and rapid delivery, introducing the content. Upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM with a prominent synth bassline and kick drum starts immediately. (2) A loud 'clapping' or 'thud' sound effect triggers a transition. The music continues without interruption, while the male voice maintains high arousal as he begins reviewing the products. (3) A distinct 'slurping' sound and chewing noises are captured as he tastes the noodles. The BGM remains in the background at a moderate volume, providing a consistent rhythmic bed. (4) A sharp 'impact' sound effect occurs as the female voice enters with laughter. The male voice continues to speak excitedly, often overlapping with the female co-host's playful reactions. (5) A final 'stinger' or 'pop' sound effect marks a dramatic reaction to the spiciness of the second bowl, with the male voice increasing in volume and pitch to emphasize the sensation.
